Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we have the same page and clear next steps: 

Summary of what you shared
- Primary goal: Reduce per-query inference cost for your agent pipeline while keeping median latency under 250ms for 1-2 concurrent users per session.
- Current stack: In-house LLM serving on GPU VMs + caching layer; some requests spike during business hours causing tail latency.
- Compliance: Data residency in us-west, SOC 2 in progress, need audit logs exposed to auditors.

How Redwood can help (high level)
- Dedicated GPU pools with predictable throughput and autoscaling to avoid tail latency spikes.
- Intelligent KV/prefix caching for repeated conversation state to cut per-token costs ~20-30%.
- Private deployment option (VPC) + audit logging to support your SOC 2 timeline.

Proposed next steps
1) Technical deep-dive with your infra lead (approx. 60 min) - scope: current inference pipeline, token distributions, and SLOs.
2) Draft of a small POC: 2-week proof to validate latency and cost improvements on a slice of traffic.
3) High-level pricing estimate (attached) and mutual action plan.

Availability: I'm available next Tues/Wed (2/24 or 2/25) 10-3 PT - happy to coordinate with your infra team.

Attached: redwood-briefing.pdf (short product + architecture notes), rwi-estimate-aurora.xlsx (ballpark estimate by throughput).

If this looks right, I'll schedule the deep-dive and loop in our solutions engineer.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
